answer:

Pepys’s diary entries routinely refer to Montagu – who was his cousin and the senior officer with whom Pepys served as secretary – in December entries from 1660‑1667. In the December 1668 entries Montagu is absent, making him the one named in every other December.  Evidence for this appears in the diaries themselves and in secondary commentary such as the Facebook discussion “Pepys Diary December Naval Figure Mentioned Every December Except December 1668”, where Montagu is explicitly identified as the recurring naval figure.
